verdict.rationale: Featurebase offers embeddable widgets and a custom-domain hosted portal (docs-8, docs-9) and a JS SDK for its messenger widget (probe-1), which could be used to link into the feedback portal, but there is no explicit documentation showing a simple 'add a link to the portal' feature or snippet. missing for 10: explicit docs/snippet for adding a direct link/button to the feedback portal, confirmation of a simple hosted portal URL usage pattern.
